meta.name: seo-vs-ads
meta.description: Find money leaking between search ads and SEO — queries you pay for while already ranking organically, and paid queries with no organic coverage. Use when asked "am I paying for clicks I'd get free", "brand bidding waste", "SEO vs ads overlap", or "cut wasted ad spend with SEO".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 找出付费广告与自然排名重叠的关键词,砍掉白花的点击预算
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每月投搜索广告,却不确定哪些词已靠自然流量免费拿到。
copy.tagline_en: Find paid keywords you already rank for and cut wasted search ad spend.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run search ads and wonder which paid clicks you'd get free.

howto.what: 把 Google Ads 搜索词报告与 Search Console 自然排名按查询词对齐,分出「重复付费」「合理投放」「仅有付费」「仅有自然」四类,估算季度浪费金额,并列出建议添加的否定词和待建页面。需 Ryze MCP 连接器同时接入广告账户与 Search Console。
howto.when: 当你问「我是不是在为本来免费的点击付费」「品牌词竞价浪费」「SEO 与广告重叠」等,或想削减与自然排名重叠的广告支出时触发。

say.text: 帮我查哪些搜索词我既在投广告又自然排名前三
我的品牌词广告是不是在和自然排名重复花钱?
say.note: 按品牌词汇总重复支出金额

say.text: 给我该加的否定关键词和该建的页面清单
say.note: 输出具体否定词与页面建议

howto.what_en: Claude joins your Google Ads search terms with Search Console queries, buckets them as double-paying, defensible, paid-only or organic-only, estimates quarterly wasted spend, and lists negatives to add and pages to build. Needs the Ryze MCP connector with both accounts.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask whether you're paying for clicks you'd already get free, about brand bidding waste, or SEO vs ads overlap, or want to cut wasted ad spend with SEO.

say_en.text: Show me which search terms I both pay for and rank top 3 for organically
say_en.note: Runs Ads and Search Console data, lists overlap terms

say_en.text: Are my brand terms double-spending on ads and organic?
say_en.note: Sums duplicate spend on brand terms

say_en.text: List the negatives to add and the pages to build
say_en.note: Outputs exact negatives and page suggestions
